declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. None of the 18 pending cases reaches that threshold; the most substantive sections involved (IPC 353, 384, 224, 448, 427, 147, 506) each cap out at 2-3 years, and several entries cite only CrPC 151 (a preventive-detention provision, not a charge) or Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act. Zero convictions; one case (Cr No 38/2023, II AJFCM Ongole) shows 'Charges Framed: Yes' (05 May 2023).
